given: the operator is filing a stock record for a SKU at a location
when: a combined tracking code (inventory_code encoding location, batch, and serial together) is supplied with the filing
then: the filed stock record holds that combined tracking code exactly as supplied

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the record captures SKU, location, and quantity; this adds the distinct outcome that the combined tracking code is persisted on the record. A record could be created with correct SKU/location/quantity yet drop or corrupt the tracking code, failing this AC while AC1 stays green.

architectural_notes: API-layer AC on the same filing boundary (app/routes) -> stock service (app/services) -> stock repository (app/repositories) path. The inventory_code is an attribute on the stock model persisted by the repository; the boundary passes it through unmodified and the service applies no transformation, so exact-value fidelity is a repository/model persistence concern, not boundary logic. Verified by a real-branch integration test round-tripping the supplied tracking code.
